brief.evidence_unit: keyed semantic projection of one published comment, per facet k (30), projection units; NOT a facet/personality score
brief.context: c = +1 if venue in TOP20 else -1; TOP20 = 20 most frequent venues in source_train history events (count desc, name asc); author-chosen, descriptive not causal

targets.choice_composition: pi_u = P(TOP20 venue | author) from history, Beta(1,1)
targets.level: beta0 of m_u(c) = beta0 + beta1 c (average of the two class means)
targets.contrast: Delta_u = m_u(+1) - m_u(-1) = 2 beta1 (primary conditional response)

brief.kernel: per facet: source_train history OLS on [1,c] for authors with >=2 events per class; pooled sigma2; Sigma = cov(beta) - mean sampling cov, eigenvalue floor 1e-6 x mean diag cov(beta); Gaussian BLUP with each author's own design
brief.support: contrast 'observed' if >=1 history event in each class, else 'model_borrowed'
brief.reference: source_train BLUP score mean/SD per facet and target

empirical_checks_held.E1: future class means vs predicted m_u(c), cells with >=1 future event; MSE vs global (source_train history class mean) and raw author history class mean (global fallback)
empirical_checks_held.E2: corr(predicted Delta, observed future Delta) over authors with >=1 future event per class
empirical_checks_held.E3: split-half (even/odd history units) BLUP correlation for level and Delta; model-implied reliability 1 - mean post var / prior var
empirical_checks_held.E4: 95% predictive interval for future class means (post var + sigma2/n_future) coverage
empirical_checks_held.bootstrap: 2000 whole-author draws, seed 20261025; family-wise z = 3.14 (Bonferroni .05 two-sided over 30 facets) on bootstrap SE
empirical_checks_held.source_validation: same checks on source_validation as diagnostics only; not used for tuning

acceptance_frozen.contrast_supported_facet: E2 correlation and E3 contrast half-correlation both have family-wise lower bound > 0
